newsitem.title: CANADA: Court approves Horsham, Trizec merger.
newsitem.headline: Court approves Horsham, Trizec merger.

text.p: Horsham Corp and Trizec Corp Ltd said on Friday that an Ontario Court has approved the merger of the two companies into a new real estate firm, Trizec Hahn Corp.
The court approved the merger after Trizec shareholders voted overwhelmingly in favor of the transaction on Thursday, the companies said in a joint statement.

"Trizec Hahn has the financial strength, strategic vision and tremendous real estate expertise to create significant growth for its shareholders," said Peter Munk, chairman and chief executive officer.

Trizec Hahn is North America's second largest real estate company with over US$6 billion in assets. It has interests in 70 properties in the United States and Canada comprising 50 million square feet.
Trizec Hahn has three operating subsidiaries, retail unit Trizec Hahn Centers, office subsidiary Trizec Hahn Office, and Trizec Hahn Europe.
